title: [regression] "'useContext' is not exported from 'react'" error message in latest canary, works fine in v14.1.0

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

labels.name: linear: next
labels.description: Confirmed issue that is tracked by the Next.js team.

body:
### Link to the code that reproduces this issue

https://github.com/stefanprobst/issue-next-browserslist

### To Reproduce

1. clone repo, `pnpm install`
2. `pnpm run build`
3. see compilation error message:


### Current vs. Expected behavior

- when using the latest stable *version 14.1.0* there is no error message, see [this branch](https://github.com/stefanprobst/issue-next-browserslist/tree/latest-stable) in the issue reproduction
- when *not* using the edge runtime [here]() i also don't see an error message
- also not sure if this is a warning or error message (as `next build` does complete)
